summary: Implementation plan for PokeForge, a high-performance web-based binary ROM editor for Pokémon Emerald (US) featuring CRC32 validation, delta-patch workspace (.forge), real-time Map Studio with metatiles and collision layers, Database Studio (Pokémon base stats, learnsets, evolutions, items), Graphics Studio (tilesheet and 4BPP 15-bit BGR palette editor), Script & Text Studio with GBA encoding, and LZ77 re-compression export engine.
